addProductsToCart.description: The `addProductsToCart` function adds products to a cart. You must supply a `sku` and `quantity`for each product. The other parameters are specified for complex product types. The function calls the [`addProductsToCart`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/cart/mutations/add-products/) mutation.
parameters: For a child product, the SKU of its parent product.
The amount or number of an item to add.
The selected options for the base product, such as color or size, using the unique ID for an object.
An array of entered options for the base product, such as personalization text.
addProductsToCart.returns: Returns a promise that resolves to a `CartModel` object or null.
addProductsToCart.events: The event bus emits the `cart/updated` and `cart/data` events with the `CartModel` as the data payload. Additionally, it emits `cart/product/added` for new items and `cart/product/updated` for items with increased quantities. It also publishes add-to-cart or remove-from-cart events to the Adobe Client Data Layer (ACDL).

To add a configurable product to the cart

applyCouponsToCart.description: A function that applies or replaces one or more coupons to the cart.

applyGiftCardToCart.description: The applyGiftCardToCart function is used to apply a gift card to the current shopping cart. It takes the gift card code as an argument and updates the cart with the applied gift card.
parameters: The code assigned to a gift card.
applyGiftCardToCart.returns: Returns a promise that resolves to a `CartModel` object or null.
applyGiftCardToCart.events: This function emits the `cart/updated` and `cart/data` events. It also publishes add-to-cart or remove-from-cart events to the Adobe Client Data Layer (ACDL).

createEmptyCart.description: The `createEmptyCart` function creates an empty shopping cart for a guest or logged in customer. It returns a cart ID. The function calls the [`createEmptyCart`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/cart/mutations/create-empty-cart/) mutation.
createEmptyCart.returns:
The data returned is a new empty cart ID as a string:

```ts
type EmptyCartId = string;
```

If guest carts have been disabled from the Admin, the function returns an error.

getCartData.description: The `getCartData` function is mainly used internally by the `initializeCart()` and `refreshCart()` functions. If you need detailed information about the current user's shopping cart, a more optimal approach is to listen for `cart/data` or `cart/updated` events so that you do not need to make another network call.
getCartData.returns: Returns a promise that resolves to a `CartModel` object or null.

getEstimatedTotals.description: A function that returns estimated totals for cart based on an address. It takes an `address` parameter.
parameters: Defines the shipping address for the estimate.
getEstimatedTotals.returns: Returns a promise that resolves to a `CartModel` object or null.

getEstimateShipping.description: The `getEstimateShipping` function returns a list of shipping methods and the estimated shipping costs, based on the country ID. The function calls the [`estimateShippingMethods`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql-api/index.html#mutation-estimateShippingMethods) mutation.
parameters: Defines the shipping address for the estimate.
getEstimateShipping.events: The event bus emits the `shipping/estimate` event, which contains data about the address and shipping method.

getStoreConfig.description: The `getStoreConfig` function returns information about a store's configuration. The function calls the [`storeConfig`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/store/queries/store-config/) query.

initializeCart.description: The `initializeCart` function initializes a guest or customer cart. This function is automatically called during the initialize phase of a dropin's lifecycle. You do not need to call this manually. It also emits the cart/initialized and cart/data events.
initializeCart.returns: Returns a promise that resolves to a `CartModel` object or null.
initializeCart.events: The event bus emits the `cart/initialized` event and the `cart/data` event, which contains data about the address and shipping method.

refreshCart.description: The `refreshCart` function refreshes the cart data.
refreshCart.returns: Returns a promise that resolves to a `CartModel` object or null.
refreshCart.events: The event bus emits the `cart/updated` and `cart/data` events.

removeGiftCardFromCart.description: This function removes a single gift card from the cart. It function calls the [`removeGiftCardFromCart`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/cart/mutations/remove-giftcard/) mutation.
parameters: Defines the gift card code to remove.
removeGiftCardFromCart.returns: Returns a promise that resolves to a `CartModel` object or null.
removeGiftCardFromCart.events: The event bus emits the `cart/updated` and `cart/data` events.

resetCart.description: This function resets the cart drop-in. As a result, the cart ID is set to null and the authenticated status is set to false.
resetCart.returns: Returns a promise that resolves to a `CartModel` object or null.

setGiftOptionsOnCart.description: [`setGiftOptionsOnCart`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/cart/mutations/set-gift-options/) is a function that sets gift options on the cart. It takes a `giftOptions` parameter.
parameters: Defines the gift options to set.
setGiftOptionsOnCart.returns: Returns a promise that resolves to a `CartModel` object or null.
setGiftOptionsOnCart.events: The event bus emits the `cart/updated` and `cart/data` events.

updateProductsFromCart.description:
The `updateProductsFromCart` function updates cart items by either changing the quantity or removing and adding an item in one step. When passing a specified quantity, the function replaces the current quantity. Setting the quantity to 0 removes an item from the cart. The function calls the [`updateCartItems`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/cart/mutations/update-items/) mutation.

When an `optionsUIDs` array is sent along with the cart item’s UID and quantity, the function adds the item with the specified options. It removes any pre-existing item with the same UID that lacks the newly provided `optionsUIDs`. In this process, the function invokes first the [addProductsToCart](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/cart/mutations/add-products/), and later the [updateCartItems](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/cart/mutations/update-items/) mutations.
parameters: An input object that defines products to be updated.
updateProductsFromCart.returns: Returns a promise that resolves to a `CartModel` object or null.
updateProductsFromCart.events: This function emits the `cart/updated` and `cart/data` events. Additionally, it emits `cart/product/updated` event with the affected items when their quantities are changed. It also publishes add-to-cart or remove-from-cart events to the Adobe Client Data Layer (ACDL).
